A better future isn't optional.It's optimized.It's optimized.It's optimized.It's optimized.It's optimized.

At Optimizely, we believe better is always possible—and always worth the work. We’re showing up for the future with bold ideas, clear goals, and a commitment to doing good on purpose. From climate action to inclusive workplaces to ethical governance, we’re building more than software. We’re building a more sustainable tomorrow.

““

We believe that true innovation isn’t just about optimizing digital experiences—it’s about optimizing for a better, more sustainable future. Our commitment to Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) principles is rooted in the same bold thinking that drives our business. We take ownership of the challenges ahead, work together to create lasting impact, and embrace diversity and inclusion as essential drivers of progress. By holding ourselves to high standards and continuously improving, we are not only building better solutions for our customers but also a better world for future generations.

Alex Atzberger|Optimizely CEO

Less footprint. More action.

Environmental

We're minimizing our environmental impact with practical, scalable changes like proactive carbon reduction and sustainable procurement. That means:

check

Teaming up with cloud providers for emissions transparency

check

Optimizing our software for lower energy consumption

check

Promoting responsible usage to minimize our collective impact

check

Making thoughtful choices about how we travel, meet, and work

We know emissions accounting in tech is a moving target, so we're committed to better transparency. As we refine our data and strengthen partnerships, we'll explore setting absolute reduction targets.

Emissions committment

Our pledge

We’re committed to net-zero Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions through 2030, and are actively working to measure and reduce our Scope 3 emissions from a 2024 baseline.

Since 99.9% of our greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions fall into that bucket (mostly from our supply chain), we’re focused on an intensity-based emissions reduction target. This helps us track our impact relative to business growth and market shifts, providing a sharper view of our operational efficiency.


Our goal? Cut Scope 3 emissions by 30% per $1,000 in revenue by 2030, starting from a 2024 baseline.

Social

The power of people

Innovation thrives when people do. That’s why we’re serious about building a workplace where everyone belongs, grows, and thrives. We champion fair and safe working conditions and invest in our people through continuous learning, mentorship, and advancement opportunities. Open communication and collaboration are key to creating a more responsible, forward-thinking Optimizely.

Strong ethics, smart oversight

Governance

Governance isn’t a checkbox—it's the foundation of our commitment. Our structure proactively identifies risks and opportunities to keep integrity and accountability at every level. We run a tight ship with strong board oversight to make sure system performance is well monitored and key controls are implemented.

As part of our commitment to security and operational excellence, we have successful implemented a SOC2 Type II program, ISO27001 and other frameworks and standards, see our Trust Center for more information.

Security, trust, and transparency are non-negotiables for us. Our strict anti-corruption policies reinforce our zero-tolerance approach to unethical behavior.

Strong governance builds strong businesses—and ultimately, stronger outcomes for our customers, employees, and communities.
